motivating_result: NKR16 structured active 56/72 correct, fixed-seed random 38/72 correct, zero errors, identical 2 probe cost and strong exact symbolic information-gain controller tie; actual scientific superiority not established
scientific_question: Is +18/72 versus one SHA-seeded random comparator representative of all uniform random two-action schedules on the already-used 12 positive conjunction worlds, or a favorable single control seed? Does greedy native active beat the exact random-policy distribution with evidence-consistent abstention and no hidden counterfactual use?

source.cohorts: EXACT previously consumed NKR12/NKR13 12 synthetic conjunction worlds; no new scientific cohorts
source.initial_public: 16 observed action0/action1 outcomes on each of eight initial contexts in the fixed NKR16 action order
source.immutable_warm: 32 original old-context/action outcomes per world, must retain 384/384
source.protected: No official valid/test, no new original MiniGrid first-use, no 21.3M historical image read
source.source_identity: public source IDs only content-addressed observations, no world ID supplied to planner

protocol.exhaustive_random: ALL ordered pairs of distinct cold context IDs: 8*7=56 equally likely sequential uniform without-replacement random policies per world, with each probe action=1. The 28 unordered pairs appear exactly twice, and order is retained in the audit for parity with sequential policy.
protocol.selection: Every random schedule is committed independent of the simulator outcome before each selected action; no hidden mask or cold result can be read for selection.
protocol.native_active: Execute inherited NKR16 native structured active policy exactly once/world, two selected action=1 probes, no algorithm edits. After any selected public outcome, update only the allowed evidence.
protocol.independent_fitted_control: Implement independent parity action0 baseline and exhaustive 15 context-positive-conjunction mask filtering directly from 16 initial source observations; no reuse of native policy methods or NKR12 independent fit implementation inside the exhaustive audit. Filter masks using exactly the two executed public action consequences.
protocol.score: On exactly the six still-UNPROBED cold context action=1 outcomes per schedule, predict ONLY if every surviving operator mask agrees; otherwise abstain. Do NOT credit the two directly observed outcomes or predict on hidden unselected truth until after evidence is fixed.
protocol.actual_source: Use the already-frozen deterministic NKR12 environment, invoke env.execute on each selected action and on remaining evaluation contexts only after fitting. No hidden truth used for selection or fitting.
protocol.cost: Native active and every random arm execute exactly 2 additional source-visible action outcomes/world; report 12-world cost of 24 actions/arm and exact number of counterfactual independent arms examined for retrospective audit, not conflate them with an executable online agent.
protocol.random_distribution: For each world compute 56 matched-budget safe-unprobed-correct scores; convolve 12 world score histograms with integer polynomial DP to obtain exact 56^12 equally likely sequential-random-policy assignments and P(random_score >= native_active_score). No Monte Carlo, no model-dependent seed tuning, no resampling.
protocol.controls: Recompute previous original NKR16 one-seed active 56/72 and seed random 38/72 as exact-SHA ancestor controls. The independently informed exact entropy policy must match native active choices and correct outcomes. Report oracle best of 56 pairs as evaluator-only upper bound, NEVER an equal-information online policy.
metrics: native active total correct, covered, wrong, choices
fixed seeded random total correct, covered, wrong
exact randomized policy expected correct and variance
exact one-sided random tail probability at or above active
active's per-world rank among all 56 schedules
oracle offline max across 56 per world
all predicted errors, abstentions and provenance
one result SHA, 2-platform source parity, wall-time and per-arm source action counts

preregistered_verdict.engineering_pass: Retain prior warm memory 384/384, native independent policy parity, all 12*56 randomized schedules sourced from exactly two selected public observations, no confident wrong predictions, exact DP totals equal 56^12, source and stream custody, focused plus full root CI both OS.
preregistered_verdict.structured_robust_positive: Active total exceeds full uniform random expected correct by >=4 across 12 worlds AND exact P(random total >= active) <= 0.05 AND zero confident wrong AND native matches independent exact symbolic candidate updates, else classify STRUCTURED_RANDOM_ROBUSTNESS_NOT_ESTABLISHED. Report observed 56/72 regardless.
preregistered_verdict.no_posthoc: Never change worlds, cohorts, probe counts, candidate grammar, metric denominator, threshold, or reference random seed after any outcome. Correct harness wiring/assertion defects only and report.
preregistered_verdict.science_limit: All worlds were generated by the research code and their outcomes were consumed in NKR12-16. Exact combinatorial tail probabilities quantify this FIXED SOURCE's random scheduling robustness only; they are NOT external data statistical significance, novel cognition, or independent scientific gain above a fully fitted equivalent symbolic method.

acceptance.development: GitHub-hosted Ubuntu/Windows focused tests and frozen audit
acceptance.final: mandatory entire inherited root regression + NKR05 focused suite + independent G29 at exact final SHA/tree both OS; preserve original NKR16 and MG19 science negatives

next_science: If robust, new externally sourced unfamiliar causal-action experience and fully trained controls are still required; if not robust, stop claiming +18 as a robust general effect and pivot away from fixed synthetic grammar.
